title: Blondedaze Community Modpack 2.0
description: This modpack is for the Blondedaze bunnypile community! It centers around a Vanilla+ Experience along with Cobblemon!
body:
## ✨ Welcome to the Blondedaze Community Server! ✨

Get ready to embark on a cozy, curated adventure designed specifically for the **Blondedaze** community! This modpack is built for **Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric)** and focuses on enhancing the classic Minecraft experience without losing that "Vanilla" soul.

Whether you’re here to build the ultimate cozy cottage, hunt for rare Pokémon, or just vibe with the chat, we’ve got you covered.

### 🐾 Featured Content: Cobblemon

The star of the show! Experience a seamless integration of Pokémon into the Minecraft world. Capture, train, and battle your favorites in a way that feels like they always belonged in the blocks.

### 🛠️ The "Vanilla+" Essentials

We’ve hand-picked mods to make your life easier and your world more beautiful:

* **Performance:** Powered by **Sodium** for buttery-smooth frame rates.
* **Exploration:** Never get lost with **Xaero’s Minimap & World Map**, and discover unique treasures with **Lootr** (everyone gets their own loot!).
* **Organization:** Master your inventory with **Sophisticated Storage** and **Jade**.
* **Aesthetics & Immersion:** Express yourself with **Figura**, decorate with **Supplementaries**, and take a nap anywhere with **Comforts**.
* **Survival QOL:** Keep track of your hunger with **AppleSkin** and enjoy dozens of small tweaks that make gameplay feel "just right."

---

Join **Blondedaze** and the rest of the community as we build, explore, and catch 'em all in the most polished version of Minecraft yet. See you in-game!
